description: This file implements functions for obtaining and mixing seed material from various operating system sources, used for random number generation in the Abseil library.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropyImpl
methods.description: Reads seed material from OS entropy sources, using platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropy
methods.description: Public interface to read seed material from OS entropy sources.

methods.name: MixIntoSeedMaterial
methods.description: Mixes a sequence of values into seed material for entropy enhancement.

methods.name: GetSaltMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves a process-wide salt value for seeding random generators.
